protocol.input-serialization: Validate and serialize already loaded input boards; exact input-prefix comparison; no disk I/O, compilation or decoding
protocol.preencoded-all: Batch assembly and file I/O, one process/pipeline startup, decode/copy all pictures, diagnostics, exact returned-I420 and named-output comparisons
protocol.preencoded-outputs: Same scope, selecting named-output pictures; NVDEC skips unselected surface copies, FFmpeg still copies all pictures
protocol.host-to-outputs: Measured together: serialize/check inputs, append cached tail, write streams, then selected-output decode and exact comparisons
protocol.excluded: Compilation, motion fields, fixtures, independent formula/IR checks, reference loading, source/hash auditing, initial guard/chroma checks, network and report writing
protocol.order: Rotate case/batch/mode order after one warmup per mode
protocol.caveats: Finite batches to EOS include startup; per-job figures are amortized throughput, not individual latency. Fields are cached compile-time constants. No flow estimation, resident video service, GPU baseline or concurrent GPU workload is measured.
protocol.writer: Unmodified Writer source with postponed annotations on Python3.8; every serialized prefix checked byte for byte
